Before opening, procedures for lounge layout
This section covers the main rule first, then the reasons

Companion Animal Travel Desk lounge handling
The purpose of this section is to keep animal travel records steady, kind, and easy to follow from booking through arrival.

When a traveler comes forward with a pet booking, the desk checks the paperwork, confirms the animal details, and keeps the tone calm so the traveler feels heard. <<FACT F085>> Any missing piece should be noted right away in the record, and the traveler should be guided toward the next step without blame or fuss. The desk also makes sure the cabin team receives the right notes, since animal care in flight is a shared responsibility and everyone needs the same picture. When a carrier or pet profile raises a concern during arrival pickup, the desk follows the usual handoff path and uses the proper escalation point so the issue moves quickly and stays clear. <<FACT F107>> Staff should speak in plain words, keep sensitive details inside the file, and avoid giving mixed directions to the traveler or the cabin team. If a pet such as Penny is listed in the record, the notes should stay factual, brief, and easy for the next shift to read.

Keep the desk tidy, return forms to the correct tray, and update the log as soon as each case is settled. If anything seems uncertain, contact the senior coordinator or the duty lead for help.
